camel_example:
aliyun quotas CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'ecs.g5.2xlarge' --ProductCode 'ecs-spec' --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --DesireValue '12.0' --AliyunUids.1 '135048337611****
' --Reason 'Scale Out'
description_en: Creates batch quota increase applications for members in a resource folder. When you add a quota item to a quota template, only new members in the resource folder autocommit quota increase applications, and existing members remain unchanged. To increase quotas for existing members by using a quota template, you can select the quota template to commit batch quota increase applications for multiple members in the resource folder. Only the administrator account of the resource folder can create batch quota applications
description_zh: 当您将配额项加入配额模板时，仅资源目录中新增的成员会自动提交配额提升申请，已有成员无变化。如果您需要通过配额模板为已有成员提升配额，则可以批量选择配额模板为资源目录中的多个成员提交配额提升申请。只有资源目录的管理员账号可批量创建配额申请
kebab_example: aliyun quotas create-quota-applications-for-template --quota-category CommonQuota --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --desire-value 12.0 --reason 'Scale Out' --aliyun-uids '["135048337611****\n"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The quota type. Valid values:
CommonQuota: general quota.
FlowControl: API rate limit.
WhiteListLabel: privilege
parameters.help_zh:
配额类型。取值：
CommonQuota：通用配额。
FlowControl：API速率配额。
WhiteListLabel：权益配额
parameters.name: quota_category

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviated name of the cloud service.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviated name of a cloud service, see `ProductCode` in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0

parameters.help_en:
The quota ID.

For more information about how to obtain the quota ID of a cloud service, see `QuotaActionCode` in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html
parameters.help_zh:
配额ID。

关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html中的0
parameters.name: quota_action_code

fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

The value range of N depends on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service.
When `ProductCode` is set to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and the value of the quota dimension
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

The value range of N depends on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service.
When `ProductCode` is set to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and the value of the quota dimension
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The requested quota value.

Set the requested quota value based on the `TotalUsage` (quota usage) and `ApplicableRange` (applicable range for quota application) of the target quota in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html.
Quota applications are reviewed and approved by the technical support team of each cloud service. To increase the approval rate, specify a reasonable requested value and provide a detailed reason when you submit a quota application
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请的值。

根据https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html中目标配额的0（配额用量）和1（配额项可申请范围）来设置配额申请值。
配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由
parameters.name: desire_value

parameters.help_en:
The reason for the quota application.

Quota applications are reviewed and approved by the technical support team of each cloud service. To increase the approval rate, specify a reasonable requested value and provide a detailed reason when you submit a quota application
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请的原因。

配额申请由各云服务的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由
parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send notifications for quota application results. Valid values:

0 (default): no.
3: yes
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请结果是否发送通知。取值：

0（默认值）：否。
3：是
parameters.name: notice_type

parameters.help_en:
The language of the notification for the quota application result. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请结果通知的语言。取值：

zh（默认值）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: env_language

parameters.help_en:
The UTC time when the quota takes effect. This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).
 
If you do not specify an effective period for the current account, the commit time is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
配额生效的UTC时间。该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。
 
如果当前账号不选择生效时间，则默认为提交时间
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The UTC time when the quota expires. This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel). 

If you do not specify an expiration time for the current account, the expiration time is set to 99 years after the effective period of the current quota
parameters.help_zh:
配额失效的UTC时间。该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

如果当前账号未选择失效时间，则失效时间为当前配额生效时间开始起99年
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The list of Alibaba Cloud accounts that belong to the resource directory members for which you want to apply for quotas.

You can apply for quota increases for a maximum of 50 members at a time. For more information about the members of a resource directory, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604207.html
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请的资源目录成员的阿里云账号（主账号）列表。

单次最多只支持为50个成员批量申请提升配额。关于资源目录的成员，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604207.html
parameters.name: aliyun_uids
